verdict.rationale: Jira's own features page lists "SAML & SSO" as a capability, so the product claims to secure organization access this way. The evidence is only a bare feature label, with no detail on setup, identity-provider support, enforcement or plan requirements. Missing for 10: documentation of SAML/SSO configuration and supported identity providers, enforcement and org-level access controls, plan or tier requirements, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can secure organization access with SSO and SAML
